title: Sapiver Forge Daily Brief — 2026-10-18
practical_takeaway: If you received an OpenCode Console breach notice, revoke and replace any linked third-party API keys at each provider, inspect recent usage and billing, and follow the provider's incident guidance. If you did not receive a notice, OpenCode says you were outside the affected group; you can still review where your credentials are stored. Restrict permissions and use separate keys per tool where possible.
